chromix.groups.identityDesc.en: One immutable launch persona is shared by renderers and workers. An unset field writes no override.
chromix.groups.identityDesc.zh: One immutable launch persona is shared by renderers and workers. An unset field writes no override.

chromix.groups.hardwareDesc.en: Presentation settings do not allocate CPU cores or change V8 heap limits.
chromix.groups.hardwareDesc.zh: Presentation settings do not allocate CPU cores or change V8 heap limits.

chromix.groups.gpuDesc.zh: Native is the ordinary launch default. …

chromix.groups.fontsDesc.zh: Use actual installed fonts. A family name is not a font file or a DirectWrite rasterizer.

chromix.groups.storageDesc.en: Quota is a launch-local backend policy, not a disk reservation. Zero is a valid quota.
chromix.groups.storageDesc.zh: Quota is a launch-local backend policy, not a disk reservation. Zero is a valid quota.

chromix.groups.networkDesc.zh: IP overrides change local ICE/SDP/stats presentation, not sockets, STUN success or routing. …

chromix.form.intro.en: Every field starts unset. Changes update SDK options for the outer Save action; they do not launch a browser. Numeric flags remain exact strings, including uint64 seeds. Unknown arguments and SDK properties are preserved.
chromix.form.intro.zh: Every field starts unset. Changes update SDK options for the outer Save action; they do not launch a browser. Numeric flags remain exact strings, including uint64 seeds. Unknown arguments and SDK properties are preserved.

chromix.form.contractNote.en: This is the public source contract, not proof that an installed binary supports it. Use a matching rebuilt browser and SDK. Raw aliases retain SDK precedence; editing one parameter never clears its other aliases or unrelated settings.
chromix.form.contractNote.zh: This is the public source contract, not proof that an installed binary supports it. Use a matching rebuilt browser and SDK. Raw aliases retain SDK precedence; editing one parameter never clears its other aliases or unrelated settings.

chromix.form.footerNote.en: Additional SDK objects (including viewport, contextOptions and launchOptions) remain available in the outer SDK JSON editor. Warnings do not normalize or delete stored values. The matching SDK performs final launch validation.
chromix.form.footerNote.zh: Additional SDK objects (including viewport, contextOptions and launchOptions) remain available in the outer SDK JSON editor. Warnings do not normalize or delete stored values. The matching SDK performs final launch validation.

chromix.field.rawAliasNote.en: Editing the raw alias. Public aliases are preserved and can be selected separately.
chromix.field.rawAliasNote.zh: Editing the raw alias. Public aliases are preserved and can be selected separately.

chromix.validation.lineBreak.en: An argument contains a line break. Use SDK JSON to preserve that value exactly.
chromix.validation.lineBreak.zh: An argument contains a line break. Use SDK JSON to preserve that value exactly.

chromix.rawArgs.title.en: Raw options.args — one flag per line
chromix.rawArgs.title.zh: Raw options.args — one flag per line

chromix.rawArgs.desc.en: Complete options.args array, including unknown flags and duplicates. Use --key=value (spaces inside the value are literal); no shell splitting or automatic alias cleanup. Apply updates options only; the outer Save still persists it.
chromix.rawArgs.desc.zh: Complete options.args array, including unknown flags and duplicates. Use --key=value (spaces inside the value are literal); no shell splitting or automatic alias cleanup. Apply updates options only; the outer Save still persists it.

chromix.rawArgs.discard.zh: 丢弃草稿并重载当前参数

chromix.profileOptions.jsonObject.en: SDK options must be a JSON object.
chromix.profileOptions.jsonObject.zh: SDK options must be a JSON object.

chromix.profileOptions.intro.en: These settings apply when Chromix is selected in Settings → Browser engine. Each profile stores its own SDK options. Profile keys override global SDK defaults; arrays and nested objects replace the matching global value. Empty options inherit global defaults. The other engines keep using the original Fingerprint section.
chromix.profileOptions.intro.zh: These settings apply when Chromix is selected in Settings → Browser engine. Each profile stores its own SDK options. Profile keys override global SDK defaults; arrays and nested objects replace the matching global value. Empty options inherit global defaults. The other engines keep using the original Fingerprint section.

chromix.profileOptions.desc.en: Edit any JSON-serializable SDK option, including args, contextOptions, launchOptions, viewport and humanConfig. Apply JSON to update the form before saving. The CDP sidecar rejects the separate measured-device devicePool mode.
chromix.profileOptions.desc.zh: Edit any JSON-serializable SDK option, including args, contextOptions, launchOptions, viewport and humanConfig. Apply JSON to update the form before saving. The CDP sidecar rejects the separate measured-device devicePool mode.

chromix.editor.nodeHint.en: Enter a Node.js executable path or node.
chromix.editor.nodeHint.zh: Enter a Node.js executable path or node.

chromix.editor.nodeDefault.en: Default: node (from PATH). Use an absolute executable path if the desktop app cannot find Node.js.
chromix.editor.nodeDefault.zh: Default: node (from PATH). Use an absolute executable path if the desktop app cannot find Node.js.

chromix.editor.envHint.en: Environment values must all be strings (including numbers and booleans, written in quotes).
chromix.editor.envHint.zh: Environment values must all be strings (including numbers and booleans, written in quotes).

chromix.editor.intro.en: Global settings for all Chromix profiles. Save explicitly, then restart the app to apply changes to browser startup. Switching engines does not erase this configuration.
chromix.editor.intro.zh: Global settings for all Chromix profiles. Save explicitly, then restart the app to apply changes to browser startup. Switching engines does not erase this configuration.

chromix.editor.fixJsonHint.en: Correct SDK options JSON to edit the structured fingerprint fields. Your draft is preserved.
chromix.editor.fixJsonHint.zh: Correct SDK options JSON to edit the structured fingerprint fields. Your draft is preserved.

chromix.editor.save.savedRestartTheApp.en: Saved. Restart the app to apply.
chromix.editor.save.savedRestartTheApp.zh: Saved. Restart the app to apply.

chromix.editor.save.unsavedChangesSaveBe.en: Unsaved changes — save before leaving this page.
chromix.editor.save.unsavedChangesSaveBe.zh: Unsaved changes — save before leaving this page.

chromix.editor.humanizeNote.en: SDK humanize only affects SDK Playwright page objects. Existing MCP/CDP actions still use Cloaksession's current driver, not the SDK's humanized mouse or keyboard methods.
chromix.editor.humanizeNote.zh: SDK humanize only affects SDK Playwright page objects. Existing MCP/CDP actions still use Cloaksession's current driver, not the SDK's humanized mouse or keyboard methods.

chromix.editor.devicePoolNote.en: devicePool requires the matching Python SDK and matching browser binary through a separate measured-device entry point. Cloaksession's CDP sidecar rejects devicePool and measured mode because that entry point excludes host CDP overrides. The example below is for direct SDK use only.
chromix.editor.devicePoolNote.zh: devicePool requires the matching Python SDK and matching browser binary through a separate measured-device entry point. Cloaksession's CDP sidecar rejects devicePool and measured mode because that entry point excludes host CDP overrides. The example below is for direct SDK use only.

chromix.editor.reservedArgsNote.en: Cloaksession supplies profile storage by default and reserves debugging arguments, including --remote-debugging-port, --remote-debugging-address and --remote-debugging-pipe. Do not override them in args, launchOptions or contextOptions.
chromix.editor.reservedArgsNote.zh: Cloaksession supplies profile storage by default and reserves debugging arguments, including --remote-debugging-port, --remote-debugging-address and --remote-debugging-pipe. Do not override them in args, launchOptions or contextOptions.

chromix.editor.examplesNote.en: Reference examples, not defaults or a field whitelist. Replace paths, credentials and persona values before use. Omit userDataDir to keep Cloaksession's per-profile storage; an explicit path overrides it and must not be shared by concurrent profiles. Availability depends on the installed SDK and matching native binary; consult the official README above.
chromix.editor.examplesNote.zh: Reference examples, not defaults or a field whitelist. Replace paths, credentials and persona values before use. Omit userDataDir to keep Cloaksession's per-profile storage; an explicit path overrides it and must not be shared by concurrent profiles. Availability depends on the installed SDK and matching native binary; consult the official README above.

mcp.feedHint.zh: Connect a client above, launch a profile, and every MCP tool call the agent makes shows up here — with sanitized arguments, outcome, and duration.

mcp.copyForLlm.title.zh: Copy a prompt you can paste into Claude Code / Cursor to set up the connection

settings.intro.en: MCP server, browser startup, archives and build info. Configuration is stored locally. Chromix SDK downloads and optional GeoIP lookups follow your SDK settings.
settings.intro.zh: MCP 服务器、浏览器启动、归档与构建信息。配置保存在本地。Chromix SDK 下载与可选的 GeoIP 查询遵循你的 SDK 设置。

settings.mcp.desc.en: Local HTTP transport that Cursor / Claude Desktop / Cline / any MCP client connects to. Requires the auth token below. The MCP tab has ready-to-paste client configs.
settings.mcp.desc.zh: 本地 HTTP 传输，供 Cursor / Claude Desktop / Cline / 任意 MCP 客户端连接。需要下方的认证令牌。MCP 标签页提供可直接粘贴的客户端配置。

settings.engine.desc.en: Global startup setting. Restart the app to apply; switching engines keeps each engine's saved configuration.
settings.engine.desc.zh: 全局启动设置。重启应用后生效；切换引擎会保留各引擎已保存的配置。

settings.chromix.desc.en: Full SDK JSON, Node.js runtime and environment overrides. Changes apply after the next app restart.
settings.chromix.desc.zh: 完整 SDK JSON、Node.js 运行时与环境覆盖项。更改在下次重启应用后生效。

settings.binary.descChromix.en: Use a matching Chromix executable. With no custom path, binary resolution and downloads are handled by the Chromix SDK, not the CloakBrowser / Chrome for Testing downloader. Restart the app to apply.
settings.binary.descChromix.zh: 使用匹配的 Chromix 可执行文件。未指定自定义路径时，二进制解析与下载由 Chromix SDK 处理，而非 CloakBrowser / Chrome for Testing 下载器。重启应用后生效。

settings.binary.descDefault.en: Point Cloaksession at your own Chromium / CloakBrowser executable instead of auto-downloading. Restart the app to apply.
settings.binary.descDefault.zh: 让 Cloaksession 指向你自己的 Chromium / CloakBrowser 可执行文件，而不是自动下载。重启应用后生效。

settings.binary.pathAria.zh: 浏览器可执行文件路径

settings.binary.skipDownload.en: Skip Chromix SDK auto-download (use a local or SDK-cached binary)
settings.binary.skipDownload.zh: 跳过 Chromix SDK 自动下载（使用本地或 SDK 缓存的二进制）

settings.binary.skipDownloadLegacy.en: Skip auto-download (use cached binary or the custom path above)
settings.binary.skipDownloadLegacy.zh: 跳过自动下载（使用缓存二进制或上方的自定义路径）

settings.binary.offlineNote.en: For offline Chromix launches, use an installed SDK cache entry, a custom binary path or CLOAKBROWSER_BINARY_PATH in Environment JSON. Launch fails if no local binary is available. The SDK's cache and download settings are separate from the legacy engines.
settings.binary.offlineNote.zh: 离线启动 Chromix 时，请使用已安装的 SDK 缓存条目、自定义二进制路径或环境 JSON 中的 CLOAKBROWSER_BINARY_PATH。若无可用本地二进制，启动会失败。SDK 的缓存与下载设置与旧引擎相互独立。

settings.binary.offlineNoteLegacy.en: When on, Cloaksession never fetches a browser runtime. Launch fails with a clear error if no binary is available. Pair with a custom path for fully offline setups.
settings.binary.offlineNoteLegacy.zh: 开启后，Cloaksession 不再获取浏览器运行时。若无可用二进制，启动会以明确错误失败。搭配自定义路径可实现完全离线。

settings.archives.desc.en: .mzar files are encrypted bundles of profiles — cookies, login state, fingerprints, notes — protected with a passphrase you set at export time.
settings.archives.desc.zh: .mzar 文件是浏览器配置的加密打包——Cookie、登录态、浏览器指纹、备注——由你在导出时设置的口令保护。

settings.updates.descMacos.en: Auto-install isn't available on macOS yet — we'll notify you in-app to download the new version.
settings.updates.descMacos.zh: macOS 暂不支持自动安装——我们会在应用内提示你下载新版本。

settings.updates.descDefault.en: Cloaksession checks for updates in the background and installs them on restart.
settings.updates.descDefault.zh: Cloaksession 会在后台检查更新，并在重启时安装。

settings.telemetry.desc.en: Off by default. Help gauge how many people run Cloaksession.
settings.telemetry.desc.zh: 默认关闭。帮助了解有多少人在使用 Cloaksession。

settings.telemetry.heartbeatDesc.en: When on, sends once a day: app version, OS family, and a random single-use token — no account, no persistent ID, and your IP is never stored (a coarse country is derived server-side then discarded). No profiles, proxies, or browsing are ever included. Set MULTIZEN_NO_TELEMETRY=1 to force it off.
settings.telemetry.heartbeatDesc.zh: 开启后每天发送一次：应用版本、操作系统类型和一个随机一次性令牌——不包含账号、不包含持久 ID，你的 IP 也不会被存储（服务端会推导出粗略国家后即丢弃）。绝不包含浏览器配置、代理或浏览记录。设置 MULTIZEN_NO_TELEMETRY=1 可强制关闭。

onboarding.heroSubtitle.en: Cookies, login, fingerprint, and proxy isolated per profile. Drive them yourself or via any MCP agent.
onboarding.heroSubtitle.zh: Cookies, login, fingerprint, and proxy isolated per profile. Drive them yourself or via any MCP agent.

onboarding.telemetryBody.en: Optionally send an anonymous daily heartbeat: just app version and OS family. No account, no persistent ID, and your IP is never stored. No profiles, proxies, or browsing — ever. Off unless you enable it; change it anytime in Settings.
onboarding.telemetryBody.zh: Optionally send an anonymous daily heartbeat: just app version and OS family. No account, no persistent ID, and your IP is never stored. No profiles, proxies, or browsing — ever. Off unless you enable it; change it anytime in Settings.
